name: Laurie Babin
bio: Laurie Babin, a Canadian actress from Quebec, gained recognition for her award-winning performance in "Red Rooms" (Les Chambres rouges), securing the Prix Iris for Best Supporting Actress at the 25th Quebec Cinema Awards in 2023. Her notable roles span films such as "The Passion of Augustine" (La Passion d'Augustine), "The Little Girl Who Was Too Fond of Matches" (La petite fille qui aimait trop les allumettes), and "Before We Explode" (Avant qu'on explose), along with the TV series "The Night Logan Woke Up" (La nuit où Laurier Gaudreault s'est réveillé).
